topics.title: Select collection methods: Select, trial and refine methods for data collection

questions.stem: Sam surveyed all the children in his school to find the month of their birthday. What would be the best title for his picture graph?
options: Birthdays of the Children in Sam's Class
Birthday Months of the Children in Sam's School
Most Popular Birthdays in Sam's School
questions.hint: Check two details: WHO did Sam survey (his whole school, not just his class) and WHAT data did he record (birthday months)?

keyPoints.note: The title must say "School", not just "Class".
A good graph title states both the topic and the group surveyed.

steps.explain: Check who Sam surveyed: the problem says "the children in his school" (total 358 children), not just one class.

Eliminate "Sam's Class" (wrong group), "Most Popular Birthdays" (vague), and "Favourite Months" (wrong topic).
steps.work: \(\text{Only "Birthday Months of the Children in Sam's School" is accurate}\)

questions.stem: Would it be helpful for Sam’s birthday picture graph to have a symbol representing \(100\) children?
options: Yes, because there are more than 100 children in every month
No, because the largest month has only 50 children, so the 100 symbol would never be used
Yes, because 100 is easier to count than 10
No, because picture graphs can only use symbols for 1
questions.hint: Look at the highest count in any single month (April = 50). Can any month use a symbol worth 100?

keyPoints.note: Compare the symbol value (100) to the highest monthly data value (50).

steps.explain: Find the largest number of children in any single month from the table: April has \(50\) children.

questions.stem: What survey question did Sam ask the children in his school to collect the data in this table?
options: What is your favourite month in the year?
In what month is your birthday?
What did you do for your birthday?
questions.hint: Look at the column heading "Birthday month" to see what single piece of information Sam needed from each child.

keyPoints.note: A survey question must produce the exact categories shown in the table.
